summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Epsilon brochure-gated download flow, Testimonials, Future Roles, updated Faculty (Kent Oliver Bhupathi + 4 guest lecturers) and fee update to Rs 89,000. Backend pytest suite expanded from 9 to 15 tests; all pass. Brochure leads endpoint behaves correctly (POST creates lead with no _id leak, GET lists sorted desc, optional current_role works, EmailStr validation returns 422). Static /brochure.pdf is served (200 OK, valid PDF magic bytes, >1MB). Existing /api/applications and /api/contacts still work end-to-end with the new BackgroundTasks-based email helper (no errors with RESEND_API_KEY empty, request returns immediately as designed). Playwright UI flows pass: hero/footer/finalCTA brochure buttons open BrochureDialog; empty-form validation toast appears; valid form submission creates lead, triggers PDF download (suggested filename Epsilon_Brochure.pdf), shows success toast and closes dialog; hero stat cell displays Rs 89,000; Testimonials renders 4 cards (testimonial-0..3); FutureRoles renders 6 cells (role-0..5); Faculty shows Kent Oliver Bhupathi as lead plus all 4 brochure guest lecturers (Jayprakash Mistry, Philip Wiseman, Alena Savera, Mardoqueo Arteaga); Apply and Schedule-a-call dialogs still open from Hero.
critical_code_review_comments: send_admissions_email is correctly gracefully no-op when RESEND_API_KEY is empty. BackgroundTasks wraps it via asyncio.run inside a thread so it does not block or error the request - verified live.
BrochureLead model uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and DB queries project {_id: 0}; no ObjectId leak confirmed via tests.

BrochureDialog.jsx uses native <a download> click for PDF - works as expected via /brochure.pdf static asset; lead persistence verified via /api/brochure-leads list endpoint (DB write is what matters, browser download is a side-effect).
Suggestion (non-blocking): Consider adding a 'thank-you' confirmation email back to the prospect (currently only admissions team gets one) once RESEND_API_KEY is configured.
Suggestion (non-blocking): Phone field has no format validation server-side; if international rollout, add regex or libphonenumber check.
Suggestion (non-blocking): /api/brochure-leads, /api/applications, /api/contacts are unauthenticated public endpoints - add basic rate limiting (slowapi) to prevent abuse before production launch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (3 brochure entry points, empty-submit validation toast, valid submit -> POST + download + dialog close, hero fee Rs 89,000, 4 testimonials, 6 future roles, faculty content, Apply/Schedule dialogs still open)

seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed brochure leads, applications and contacts via API and UI submissions.
